title: Some Countries Exist Only on Paper
summary: A short CGP Grey explainer about how countries are defined, why recognition by others matters, and the oddities of places like Taiwan and Vatican City. It shows that statehood is partly a matter of diplomacy rather than fact.
why: Cited in threads on borders, Taiwan's status and how many countries exist, as a quick explanation of why recognition is political.
